svg.text: Measures grains from a photo. Gaussian blur, Otsu threshold, then a distance
transform feeds Watershed to pull apart particles that are touching. For every
grain you get area, equivalent and Feret diameters, aspect ratio and
sphericity, plus the D10, D50 and D90 for the sample as a whole. It writes out
a colored overlay, the PSD curve, a CSV per particle and a summary JSON. Runs
as a CLI or as a Python API.
